mapper.select: SELECT p.task_id, p.participant_id, p.member_id, p.status, p.complete_time, p.complete_remark, p.complete_images, p.reject_reason, m.nickname, m.avatar FROM t_task_participant p INNER JOIN t_wx_member m ON m.member_id = p.member_id WHERE p.task_id = #{taskId} AND p.deleted_flag = #{deletedFlag} ORDER BY p.participant_id ASC
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO t_task_participant (task_id, member_id, status, deleted_flag, create_time, update_time) VALUES
(#{item.taskId}, #{item.memberId}, #{item.status}, #{item.deletedFlag}, #{item.createTime}, #{item.updateTime})
